facts.text: I recently turned 32.
I feel like I am at a crossroads in my career.
I am not sure if I am on the right path in my career.
I need to focus on figuring out my values, interests, and strengths.
I have been doing the same job for a while.
I am not sure if my current job still aligns with what I want.
I feel like I am at a new stage in my life.
I want to make sure I am on the right path.
I will start with a values exercise.
I want to make sure I am doing something that aligns with what is important to me.
I have been feeling restless and uncertain about my career.
I feel like I should have a better sense of direction since I am 32.
I will start with brainstorming values.
I will write down all the values that come to mind.
I will categorize and prioritize the values.
I am curious to see what comes out on top.
I am not sure if my current job aligns with my values.
I have written down about 15 values that are important to me.
One value that is standing out to me is work-life balance.
I need to make more time for my personal life and relationships.
My current job can be demanding.
I often work long hours in my current job.
I often check work emails and messages outside of work.
I am not sure if my current work situation is sustainable for me long term.
Another value that is important to me is creativity.
I enjoy problem-solving and finding innovative solutions.
My current role does not always allow for creativity and problem-solving.
I feel stagnant and unchallenged in my current role.
I will start by talking to my current employer about making changes to my role.
I want to incorporate more creativity and problem-solving into my work.
I want to discuss ways to improve my work-life balance with my employer.
I want to gather specific examples of what I am looking for in terms of creative challenges and work-life balance before the conversation.
I want to think about what I am willing to compromise on and what my non-negotiables are.

keyphrases: creative challenges and work-life balance conversation
